$comment: Design tokens of the Blätter layouts (website, archive, status page). Edit only this file, then run ./design build. Format: see README.md.

text.note: dark: not pure white, which glares

red.note: the red of the »Blätter« logo (no Pantone base); until 11/2026 the website used #E71835. Dark: the website's red-light for text (the logo red has only 3.9:1 on the dark page, text needs 4.5:1); backgrounds, frames and lines keep the logo red (3:1 is enough there)

red-light.use: lighter red; in the archive the dark theme's red text (see red.dark)

red-dark.use: website: hover of red buttons (white text on it)
red-dark.note: darker instead of lighter on hover: white on the lighter red had only 3.8:1

link.note: dark: own value (the website's blue-light #097EB2 has only 4.0:1 on the dark page); button backgrounds stay

link-on-dark.use: website: links on black or dark images (hero, poster teasers, navigation)
link-on-dark.note: the link colour of the dark theme; replaces #4AC6FF

focus.note: the website used #66AFE9 with a glow until 2026 (only 2.3:1 on white)

muted.use: grey text: meta lines, counts, sources, descriptions, quotes
muted.note: replaces #808080 as text on the website since 2026 (3.9:1 on white)

boundary.use: borders of fields, checkboxes and light buttons only (3:1 is enough, WCAG 1.4.11); never as text

marker.note: own: the website's mark is #FFFF00; calmer and still 4.5:1 for links on it

success.use: website: success messages, checklists, valid form fields

cover.$comment: Hues of the covers since the print layout of 2026; the palette stays over the years, the issues rotate through it (covers: first year). Assumed values until the designer's sRGB values for the Pantone U colours are in. Dark: mixed with 20 % white, so they keep 3:1 on the dark page. Only for bars, dots and large figures: some have less than 4.5:1 on white.

contrast.$comment: Pairs that must reach the minimum in both themes. The foreground counts as text unless "as" says border; the background as background. 4.5 for text, 3 for large text, focus outlines and component boundaries.
